rezumat: Milestones A (safe incremental collection), B (INS), C (12 entries), D (meanings and shared groups) and E (preview, coverage, report) are complete.

Structured field evidence now covers {with_fields} of {finder} projects and resources (baseline 14). The retained sources are {source_urls} URLs ({parsed} parsed, {failed} failed) with {field_records:,} field records.
Each field record is a path in a source. The proposals are {groups} shared groups (baseline 7), 16 provider review items and the dictionary evidence that `inventory.py --check` verifies.
The public build is unchanged: the default payload equals the v0.13.0 payload apart from its generation time; classifications and accepted providers are identical.
Collection used {direct_requests} direct requests in total ({browser_navigations} browser navigations); the 150-request limit of lot C was not reached.

Batch C2 (three active projects): three inventories (`romania-interactiva` 10 sources, `data-expertforum` 15 sources from the owner's saved page and 14 Google Sheet tabs, `bani-partide` 1 source from the owner's saved listing), 8 proposed groups and provider items D176–D187; see the subsection of section 3.

monitorul-ai.rezultat: Public archive of Romanian parliamentary stenograms (Monitorul Oficial, Part II). Two design documents show the record shapes: a document envelope, session metadata, agenda items, speeches, votes with counts for, against and abstaining, speaker identity (name, title, role, party group, person id) and source spans. data-expertforum.rezultat: Portal of data sets that Expert Forum (EFOR) compiled for its projects. The page is a copy that the owner saved from their browser on 2026-10-26 (expertforum.ro and its subdomains are on the list of hosts that no script requests). It lists 15 data sets in five categories (Electoral 4, Finanțare politică 1, Infrastructură 6, Media 1, Sănătate 3). Each has a subcategory, a title, a description, related EFOR reports and a link. Eleven data sets link 14 Google Sheet tabs, one links a Drive file (political finance) and three share one Drive folder (health procurement). The pass read each of the 14 tabs once, through its CSV export (docs.google.com, no retry): 10 were parsed (100 field records, one for each header cell) and 4 answered with more than 2,000,000 bytes and were not parsed. Three tabs needed a header option (a title above the header, empty header cells). The page declares no column, no period, no licence and no named institution; it says that EFOR processed the data from public information or from information obtained under the access-to-information law, and it asks the user to cite the source. The facts of the page (category, title, description, reports, the label of a link) have exact locators in the registry and in the data set list of the page source. One provider is named in the evidence: the tab of HG 1088/2021 has a column `sursa` that holds „HG 1088/2021” in every row, and the page labels the second tab „HG 1264/2021 (Ciucă)” (review item D186). Three groups are proposed (`uat`, `partid-politic`, `beneficiar-fonduri-publice`) and eight selectors are listed as candidates for five reviewed groups (`siruta`, `cui`, `judet`, `localitate`, `voturi-valide`). Relation to another entry: the political finance data set has the related report https://www.banipartide.ro/ on the page. It is a relation between the two entries, not a source of either.
data-expertforum.limite_en: Four tabs are over 2,000,000 bytes and were not parsed. A Drive file and a Drive folder (three health data sets) were not requested. Tabs about persons keep the header only. The tabs declare no type, unit or description; the header is the only evidence.
data-expertforum.urmator_en: Decide whether a tab over 2,000,000 bytes may be read with a bounded request for its header (--sample-bytes; Google ignores the byte range, so the start of the response is read). Decide the eight candidate selectors, the three proposed groups and D186. The owner can save the Drive file and the folder from a browser if the headers are wanted.
data-expertforum.blocaj_en: Four tabs answered with more than 2,000,000 bytes (the fetcher refuses them) and have no header. The Drive file (political finance) and the Drive folder (health) were not requested: the page does not say that the file is a spreadsheet, a folder cannot be listed without the API, and the finance data set has donor data about persons.

bani-partide.rezultat: Platform on political party finance in Romania since 2006 (donations, campaign finance, public subsidies, income and expenses of parties; catalogue text). Every automated request to banipartide.ro answers HTTP 403, and the host is on the list of hosts that no script requests. The owner saved the listing of its Datasette database (`https://db.banipartide.ro/banipartide.json`) from a browser on 2026-10-26 at 20:30 (+02:00), and the inventory reads that copy (part 3, brief section 8.1). The listing names the database `banipartide` (46,718,976 bytes) with 18 visible tables, 20 hidden full-text tables and 4 views (names only). The 18 tables have 172 columns, one field record for each, and 457,900 rows in all. The largest are `Donatori rapoarte de venituri și cheltuieli` (353,473 rows), `Contributii campanie` (49,697), `Donatori persoane fizice` (30,791), `Cheltuieli subventii` (8,950) and `Venituri anuale din rapoarte de venituri și cheltuieli` (3,923). The listing declares the source „Expert Forum”, the source address https://expertforum.ro/tag/finantare-politica/ and the licence CC Attribution 4.0, and the field browser credits them. It declares no type, description, unit, period or provider, so each field has a name and nothing more. The tables of donors and `Contributii campanie` hold data about persons (`Nume donator`, `CNP`, `Nume`): the inventory keeps the column names only and no row was read. Mapping: the column `Partid` of 12 tables is proposed for the group `partid-politic` and `Legenda partide.UAT` for `uat` (both groups still proposed); two groups are new (`subventie-partid`, `donatie-partid`, state `propus`); six selectors are candidates for the reviewed groups `cui`, `judet` and `perioada-de-referinta`. Providers: one proposal (D187). The table `Venituri anuale partide de la MF` names the Ministry of Finance by its initials; no other text of the copy names a provider. The source „Expert Forum” is the project author and distributor, not a provider. Relation to another entry: the political finance data set of `data-expertforum` links https://www.banipartide.ro/ as its related report; the two entries share no data source (the Drive file of that data set was not read), so nothing is counted twice.
bani-partide.limite_en: The listing declares column names and row counts only: no type, description, unit, period or provider. The four views have no columns, and the 20 hidden tables get no field. Tables of donors hold data about persons, so only the column names are kept and no row was read. The home page and the documentation pages of the project were not read (HTTP 403; host on the list).
bani-partide.urmator_en: Decide D187, the two proposed groups, the new members of the proposed groups `partid-politic` and `uat`, and the six candidate selectors for the reviewed groups `cui`, `judet` and `perioada-de-referinta`. The owner can save the JSON pages of the views (assumed to list their columns; not verified) and the documentation pages of the project (to look for AEP and Monitorul Oficial in their text).

romania-interactiva.rezultat: Platform of public tools by three lecturers of FSPAC, Babeș-Bolyai University: its home page lists 22 tools, six on the project host and the others on their own hosts. The pass read seven: the census tool (county population at eight censuses, 1948–2021), the governments timeline (28 governments), the university centres tool (students per centre and per university), the marriages and divorces map (counties, 1990–2024), the local elections map and the exam results map (both over 2,000,000 bytes, read as samples), and Orașe digitale (the e-government index of 325 cities). Each tool keeps its data in the page: script constants, a JSON data island and one HTML table. The new reader `js-literale` lists them with the types of a bounded sample; the JSON-LD `Dataset` of every page gives its name, period, licence and `isBasedOn`. Every page ends with a "Surse" or "Date" note that names its providers: INS (TEMPO matrices SCL103D, POP210A, POP212A, POP107A and census tables), Eurostat, CNFIS, AEP, the Ministry of Education (via data.gov.ro), Guvernul României, Monitorul Oficial and Agerpres; the dormitory data come from an ANOSR analysis and a Cushman & Wakefield Echinox study. Three INS matrices were read as metadata. Orașe digitale is the authors' own collection (manual coding of 46 indicators in five categories, three waves); the page names no source for the population of a city. The pages declare no field types, no units and no field descriptions, except six `variableMeasured` entries of Orașe digitale.
romania-interactiva.limite_en: Seven of 22 catalogue tools were read. Two pages are samples of 600,000 bytes (no data). Field records come from a bounded sample of script literals; short key names are not described by the pages.
romania-interactiva.urmator_en: Decide whether a response over 2,000,000 bytes may be read whole; choose more tools from the 15 that were not read (1vot.ro, geamanuleuropean.ro, sondajeleromaniei.ro, satulcaresestinge.ro); decide on the candidate selectors for the reviewed groups.
romania-interactiva.blocaj_en: The data of the local elections and exam results pages is beyond the 2,000,000-byte limit of the fetcher; the population of a city in Orașe digitale has no named source.

lista-firme.rezultat: Search by CUI or name over the Romanian companies, with an API (catalogue: `format:api`) and the repository `tudorr89/info-firme`. The API has no documentation page. The repository README (commit 1dcb375, 2026-10-24) documents `GET https://lista-firme.info/api/v1/info?cui=...` and `?name=...`; the code reads `company` and not `name`. The routes file has the one route `info` and a fallback that aborts any other API path with 401 (by the code; not requested). Neither the README nor the routes file mentions a key. The six migrations read give 51 field records (the columns of `companies`, `addresses`, `infos` and `statuses`). The terms page names the originators: ONRC (via data.gov.ro) and the public ANAF APIs. On 2026-10-27 the owner raised the request limit of the entry for one request. `GET /api/v1/info?cui=51859625` (the CUI of the operator) answered HTTP 200 with 2,276 bytes of JSON; it needed no key. It is the seventh source, with 57 field records (55 before 2026-10-27: the corrected reader adds the two empty lists as two records): key paths and observed types, no value. The response has 17 keys. Nine are columns of `companies` (`name`, `cui`, `euid`, `registration_date`, `type`, `website`, `parent_country`, `mark`, `reg_com`). One is computed: `is_active` (the scope `preferActive` of the model adds it in the query; it is not a column). Seven are relations: `address` (12 keys), `info`, `status`, `caen`, `legal_representatives`, `natural_person_representatives` and `eu_branches`. Against the migrations the API hides `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` of `companies`, and `id`, `company_id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` of `addresses`. `status` holds only `details` (`code` and `description`): none of the five `statuses` columns read appears. The relation `caen` has three elements, each with `code`, `version` and the same seven keys under `caen_details` and `details`. The relation `legal_representatives` has one element with 14 keys, among them the name, the birth date and place and the current location of a natural person. It keeps `id`, `company_id`, `created_at` and `updated_at`: the API hides keys of this kind for the company and the address. For this company `info` is null, so the 18 columns of `infos` were not observed. `natural_person_representatives` and `eu_branches` are empty lists (each is a field of the type array with 0 elements), so the keys of their elements are unknown. Three candidate members are proposed for the reviewed groups `cui`, `judet` and `localitate`: the paths `$.cui`, `$.address.county` and `$.address.city` of the response. The two provider items D189 and D190 are decided. A group for the CAEN code is a suggestion only (section 5).
limite: Cheile vin dintr-un singur răspuns real al API-ului, pentru o singură firmă (CUI-ul operatorului). Relația `info` este nulă, deci cele 18 coloane ale tabelului `infos` nu au fost observate. `natural_person_representatives` și `eu_branches` sunt liste goale, deci cheile lor nu sunt cunoscute. Cheia `mark` a fost doar nulă, deci tipul ei nu este cunoscut.

Citirea migrărilor dă coloanele tabelelor, nu cheile răspunsului. Doar migrarea de creare a tabelelor `addresses`, `infos` și `statuses` a fost citită; migrările ulterioare ale tabelului `statuses` (două) nu au fost citite. Tabelele reprezentanților legali, ale reprezentanților persoane fizice, ale sucursalelor și ale codurilor CAEN nu au fost citite (limita de 15 cereri). Răspunsul arată cheile relațiilor `caen` și `legal_representatives`, nu coloanele tabelelor lor.

Răspunsul conține date despre o persoană fizică: nume, data și locul nașterii, locația curentă. Inventarul păstrează numele cheilor și tipurile observate, nu valorile. Termenii site-ului interzic colectarea în masă, deci nu s-a făcut o a doua cerere.
README-ul spune `?name=`, iar codul citește `company`: documentația și codul nu coincid. Interogarea după nume nu a fost cerută.
lista-firme.limite_en: The keys come from one response of the deployed API, for one company (the operator). `info` is null, so the 18 columns of `infos` were not observed. `natural_person_representatives` and `eu_branches` are empty lists, so their keys are unknown. `mark` was null only, so its type is unknown. The 51 migration columns come from a recorded commit. Only the creation migrations of `addresses`, `infos` and `statuses` were read; two later migrations change `statuses`. The tables of legal representatives, natural-person representatives, EU branches and CAEN codes were not read (the limit of 15 requests). The response shows the keys of two of those relations (`caen`, `legal_representatives`), not the columns of their tables. limite: Fiecare fișier GeoJSON a fost citit ca eșantion de primii 30.000 de octeți: se cunosc câmpurile primelor clădiri complete, nu dimensiunea fișierului sau numărul de înregistrări.

dupa-cutremur.limite_en: Each GeoJSON file is a range sample of the first 30,000 bytes: the fields of the first complete features are known, the size of the file and the number of records are not. The building properties include the name of the technical expert (a person); the inventory keeps the field name and the observed type, no value. The Drive folder with the kml, csv and geojson sets and the bit.ly short link were not requested. The shelters file names no provider.
dupa-cutremur.urmatorul_pas: Decideți D203 și D204, grupul propus `coordonate-geografice` și candidatul pentru `localitate`. Dacă vreți coloanele seturilor csv, proprietarul poate exporta folderul Drive dintr-un browser și îl poate importa cu `inventory.py --import-saved`.
dupa-cutremur.urmator_en: Decide D203 and D204, the proposed group `coordonate-geografice` and the candidate for `localitate`. The owner can export the Drive folder from a browser and import it with `inventory.py --import-saved` if the columns of the csv sets are wanted.
